items.title: 54271_Charlie Holmes oral history interview
items.q: I can't tell you too much about him, because I never worked for him, but I knew people that did work for him.

ctx.x: I wanted to ask you about a musician who I know really nothing about. His name is Bobby Neal.

Yeah, Bobby Neal was a... I think he was a bass player. He used to have a band around here. I can't tell you too much about him, because I never worked for him, but I knew people that did work for him.
